Membership applications open

There’s a place for your curiosity.

Software, design, engineering, or a subject you are only beginning to explore—start with other students who want to learn too.

Free

For every current secondary-school student in Hong Kong.

No membership fee. No expertise required. Your school does not need to be on our member-school list.

What members can access

A community to learn with, plus opportunities to take your ideas further.

  • Union activities and community events
  • Selected members-only workshops and programmes
  • Priority for selected high-demand events
  • Cross-school projects and leadership opportunities

How to join

One application, followed by confirmation from our Executive Committee.

  1. Complete the application

    Tell us about yourself through the official form.

  2. Receive confirmation

    Our Executive Committee will review your application.

  3. Start taking part

    Meet the community and join upcoming opportunities.

Ready to join HKJSTU?
